entities.name: St. Christoph's Church, Mainz
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The church of St. Christoph in Mainz, known in German as St. Christoph zu Mainz, is an example of early gothic architecture. St. Christoph was originally built between 1240 and 1330. The church is associated with Johannes Gutenberg, who may have been baptised there. Christoph's Church, Mainz is a church building in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
